retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating warm, painterly album covers featuring expressive close-up portraits with 1960s-style multiline display typography.
triggerTerms: warm oil portrait of a couple

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned, painterly composition featuring two expressive, smiling faces in a tight close-up, characterized by visible brushwork and a distinctive multiline geometric title in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight proximity between the two subjects suggesting intimacy
Typography integrated into the upper quadrant, overlapping the background
Warm highlights on skin contrasting with deep brown and black hair
Diagonal movement from the bottom left to the top right through the subjects' eyelines
coreInvariants: Warm, earthy color palette dominated by browns and ambers
Multiline 'inline' style for the primary display text
High-key white for teeth and eyes to create focal points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale portraits filling the lower two-thirds and right half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open-mouthed smile of the left subject acts as the primary high-contrast anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright smile on the left, up to the eyes of the right subject, then to the stylized title in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is a textured, dark brown painterly void that recedes behind the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and sienna (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and off-white (teeth, highlights, and typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the facial features; overall warm temperature.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses 4-5 parallel concentric lines to form each letter
Secondary text is a clean, bold, condensed sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' in the main title features a long, diagonal multiline descender that follows the angle of the portrait
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex multiline display face paired with a simple, high-legibility condensed sans-serif for names and tracklists.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the multiline concentric aesthetic of the 60s/70s
Matches the secondary sans-serif for names

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of a joyful man and woman in a close-up embrace, using warm sienna and amber tones with visible, expressive brushstrokes and a dark, textured background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large multiline geometric title in the top left corner in cream color, with secondary names in a bold condensed sans-serif above it.

verificationChecks: Are the portraits painterly rather than photographic?
Is the color palette strictly warm (browns, creams, ambers)?
Is the composition a tight close-up?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in the display font
mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific artist names
Do not use the specific record label logo
Ensure the painting style is generic oil-on-canvas rather than a specific artist's hand

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible canvas or brush texture
Verify no cool colors (blue/green) are present
Ensure the subjects' expressions are highly joyful
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Oil Portrait + Multiline Geometric Typography + Warm Earth Tone Palette
